name: flux
description: Bounded local access to Flux notes, working list, and explicit Codex video handoffs.
long_description: Use Flux through ten bounded MCP tools that list, read, and create local notes, fetch complete native YouTube captions, read or replace the current working list, bind the current Codex task, and claim or complete durable video handoffs. Queueing never wakes or messages a task. The bundle cannot watch videos and does not expose arbitrary files, deletion, shell commands, cloud sync, agent routing, or secrets.

tools.name: flux_list_notes
tools.description: List Flux note metadata with optional folder and source filters.

tools.name: flux_read_note
tools.description: Read one complete Markdown note by stable identifier and folder.

tools.name: flux_create_note
tools.description: Save user-provided text as a local Markdown note.

tools.name: flux_fetch_youtube_transcript
tools.description: Fetch native YouTube captions and save the complete transcript locally.

tools.name: flux_read_working_list
tools.description: Read the current Flux working list.

tools.name: flux_bind_current_codex_task
tools.description: Bind browser Flux to the explicit current Codex task without waking it.

tools.name: flux_claim_video_handoff
tools.description: Claim the exact visible handoff ID for this task and read its preserved source transcript.

tools.name: flux_complete_video_handoff
tools.description: Publish downstream analysis for a handoff claimed by this task.

tools.name: flux_fail_video_handoff
tools.description: Mark a claimed video handoff failed while preserving its source transcript.

tools.name: flux_save_working_list
tools.description: Replace the current Flux working list with an explicit title and items.
